mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sa_study_plan (user_id, title, goal, start_date, end_date, daily_minutes, focus_topics_json, generation_status, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{goal}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{dailyMinutes}, #{focusTopicsJson}, #{generationStatus}, #{status})
mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.title, p.goal, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.daily_minutes, p.focus_topics_json, p.generation_status, p.status, p.error_message, p.create_time, p.update_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_study_plan_task t WHERE t.plan_id = p.id AND t.user_id = p.user_id) AS task_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_study_plan_task t WHERE t.plan_id = p.id AND t.user_id = p.user_id AND t.completed = 1) AS completed_task_count FROM sa_study_plan p
mapper.update: UPDATE sa_study_plan SET title = #{title}, generation_status = 'READY', error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND generation_status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE sa_study_plan SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sa_study_plan WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
